'Frontline casework at St Aidan's Parish Hall identifies three root causes', 'Each autumn, young people who engaged positively over summer withdraw from college placements within four to six weeks', and 'Our collaboration with Dunmore Sixth Form College confirms this pattern: Marlpit applicants exhibit high drop-off and early withdrawal rates'. All three were removed in the correction pass and the round-1 audit returned zero blocking claims. 5) THE INTERESTING PART, and the reason this rung exists. With the same six names but every date, number, place-anchor and role stripped, the generator did not invent replacements for the missing detail - it invented EVIDENCE INSTEAD. n06's draft-1 inventions were a street name and a local NEET statistic: missing particulars. n06thin's inventions are all assertions that the organisation has observed, tracked or confirmed something. Stripping the specifics did not reduce the invention pressure, it redirected it from nouns to epistemics. The correction pass then had to replace those with 'Our evidence rests on our direct delivery in Marlpit', which is a sentence that answers a 30-per-cent-weighted donor question ('say what your evidence for them is') with no evidence at all. 6) All six referents are used - Marlpit 9 times, Dunmore Sixth Form College 7, St Aidan's Parish Hall 7, Northgate Minibus Hire 3, Second Chances 1, Priya Raval 1 - but the thin ones are used DECORATIVELY where n06 used them structurally. In n06 the venue carried the unit cost, the vendor carried the transport line, the named person carried the staffing line and the dated result carried the indicator baselines. Here Priya Raval appears once, as 'key personnel including Priya Raval', with no role, and Second Chances appears once as 'Having delivered our Second Chances programme', with no date, scale or result. Same count, and the count metric cannot see the difference; a reader can. 7) Every baseline in the indicator table is 0, and it has to be: the thin ledger carries no prior figure to baseline against. n06 could baseline on its dated result. 8) Budget arithmetic is internally sound and I checked it deterministically: 41500+4200+2800+3100+1400 = 53000 direct; 12 per cent = 6360; total 59360, inside the 25,000-75,000 band and exactly at the 12 per cent overhead cap. Every salary and unit figure is a model-invented planning estimate with no ledger basis and is flagged nowhere by the pipeline. Currency is GBP throughout and design.budget_envelope_usd came back null, so the P2 currency defect did not bite. 9) The design stage truncated at its 6000-token cap under effort 'high' for the THIRD rung running (n03, n06, n06thin), and here needed two continuation hops rather than one. 10) Deterministic checks I ran on the delivered text: jargon regex 0 hits; consistency scan (participant-unit and month-unit numbers) 0 findings; no code fence, horizontal rule, emoji, placeholder or order id; no fabricated contact details of any kind.
